audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read Anivia while content win[0..6] read Katarina on every row, and every phases[N].why describes Katarina winning that stage. The page answers 'who wins Level 1' twice, differently.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Katarina x7, the win rate is 54.07% over 1707 games in Katarina's favour, and the content prose is unambiguous: Shunpo blinks over Crystallize, Flash Frost is slow enough to sidestep, and Rebirth gives Katarina an egg to break for a second reset.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Katarina. The whys already argued for Katarina, so no why rewrite was required.

audit.why: Level 3 (Shunpo over Crystallize), level 6 (burst to egg and break it), first item, and 2+ items are all correctly placed. Anivia's counter-spike is item-gated (RoA/Seraph's) rather than level-gated, which spikes[2] already says.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it, and the Flash Frost > Frostbite double-damage link was described only as 'her E never doubles' without Frostbite's 4s cooldown or the 1075 stun range. dontsFull[2] warned about 'spell-shield kits' — Anivia has no spell shield; the real all-in gate is Rebirth.
audit.why: Riot's Frostbite text: damage is doubled if the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or a fully formed Glacial Storm. Frostbite is 4s flat, Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7s at 1075 range, Crystallize 17s flat. Rebirth reverts her to a full-health egg on fatal damage, so an all-in without pickup damage left simply gives her the HP back.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Flash Frost 11s/1075, Frostbite 4s and Crystallize 17s with the sequencing; dontsFull[2] rewritten around Rebirth instead of a nonexistent spell shield.

edits.before: - Anivia Flash Frost (Stun): matchup-defining — The slow-moving stun starts every Anivia kill — sidestep it and her E never doubles. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Shunpo (second use) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Flash Frost (Stun): 11s at rank 1, 1075 range — sidestep it and Frostbite never doubles. - Frostbite is a 4s cooldown, so the double-damage window is the only one that matters. - Crystallize is 17s flat; Shunpo goes over it. - E's second cast is your exit, R is the finisher.

edits.before: Carry through chain reactions — one kill is three; your job is the first domino and the discipline to wait for it.
edits.after: Carry by hopping her walls — Crystallize is 17s and Shunpo blinks it, so her one anti-dive tool costs her the trade.

edits.before: You are the cleanup that starts fights: enter on steel, lotus the clump, reset through the kill, and exit through the panic.
edits.after: Enter off her stun cooldown: she has to stand in Glacial Storm to zone, and a stationary channel is what your resets eat.

edits.before: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. edits.after: Best wave: a Q-bounced thin push with daggers banked at the river mouth — your roams arrive with luggage. Worst wave: a frozen wave under her tower — every pickup walk is a Flash Frost audition. Crash timing: every crash should buy something — a reset, a plate, a roam. Autopilot shoving buys ganks.
